request.description:
# Get Pet by ID

This endpoint retrieves a specific pet from the pet store based on the provided pet ID.

## Request

### Request URL

- Method: GET
    
- URL: `https://petstore.swagger.io/v2/pet/859`
    

## Response

Upon a successful request, the server will respond with the details of the specific pet in the following format:

- Pet ID (integer)
    
- Pet Name (string)
    
- Photo URLs (array of strings)
    
- Tags (array of objects containing tag details)
    
- Status (string)
    

If the pet with the provided ID is not found, the server will respond with an appropriate error message.

request.description:
### Get Order by ID

This endpoint retrieves the details of a specific order by providing the order ID in the URL path.

#### Request Body

This endpoint does not require a request body.

#### Response Body

- `id`: The unique identifier for the order.
    
- `petId`: The ID of the pet that is being ordered.
    
- `quantity`: The quantity of the pet being ordered.
    
- `shipDate`: The date when the order is to be shipped.
    
- `status`: The status of the order.
    
- `complete`: Indicates if the order has been completed.

This endpoint is used to log out a user from the system.
